messages:
Elena: Heads upwe pulled the strict fncall validator on EU canary ~15m ago after a jump in rejected tool responses. Starting a thread to capture why and what next.
Sam: Noted. Any initial hypothesis on cause?
Elena: Early traces point at the new response-adapter that flattens arrays into single objects for legacy tool bindings. Many integrations returned arrays and validator flagged unexpected_array. Rejection rate went from ~0.3% to ~7.8% on canary nodes.
Kai: DeployBot: canary rollout 0.47 -> reverted to 0.46 by Elena (reason: fncall rejection spike).
Priya: Ouch. Can support see the reject reasons in Console? Product says they only see a generic 4xx and customer tickets are noisy.
Sam: Currently Console exposes fncall_rejects as a metric, but not the reason text due to PII concerns. We log reason strings internally.
Elena: What we need: aggregate counts of reject classes surfaced in the Console (missing_field, type_mismatch, unexpected_array) but without exposing request/response payloads. That should help support triage before blanket rollbacks.
Kai: Implementation idea: emit a compact reason_code enum into the metrics/audit pipeline and surface top N reasons in Console. No raw JSON. Feature gated per-account and redacted.
Sam: Agree. Telemetry model: reason_code (enum), validator_version, billed flag, opaque_sample_id. Keep payload snapshots minimal and sampled.
Priya: Billing impactwe currently bill fncall attempts. If we surface rejects more clearly customers will ask why they paid. We should include a billed:true/false tag in telemetry to reconcile. Any policy change needs finance/legal sign-off.
Elena: Action plan (short term): 1) Keep rollback. 2) Add reason_code enum to validation path and pipeline (100% reason_code, 1% raw snapshot). 3) Console to show aggregated, redacted validator insights. 4) Support runbook + customer comm draft.
Sam: Proposed telemetry snippet: 
validator_event: reason_code=UNEXPECTED_ARRAY|MISSING_FIELD|TYPE_MISMATCH|UNKNOWN; validator_version=v1.2.7; billed=true|false; sample_id=<opaque>
Kai: Implementation notestore reason_code as a short token, not field names, to reduce leakage. sample_id must be k-anonymized/opaque. Also add an ingestion tag for region (eu-west) so we can alert per-canary.
Elena: Rollout UX: Console toggle per-customer to enable strict validation with an auto-rollback threshold (>2% rejects over 5m). Also expose a small "validator insights" card for owners showing counts and top reasons.
Priya: I'll own the runbook and make a customer-facing blurb, legal will review PII wording. Also recommend we gate Console cards behind a feature flag for staged rollout.
Sam: I'll open a telemetry PR with schema and sampling defaults. Also add a billable_status boolean.
Kai: I'll mock the Console card and the feature flag UI. Also propose an alert rule for eng-oncall: fncall_reject_rate_eu_canary > 2% for 5m.
Sam: tagging @DevOpsBot to create the alert.
DevOpsBot: Alert created: fncall_reject_rate_eu_canary > 2% for 5m -> pager to #eng-oncall, email eng-platform oncall.
Elena: Good. Decision on re-rolling: wait for reason_code telemetry + console card + runbook. Then re-enable strict validator in canary behind the auto-rollback threshold.
Priya: Product OK as long as we have clear customer messaging and billing reconciliation. Legal wants the exact redaction language before console goes live.
Elena: Coolwe'll reconvene in 48h with PRs/mocks/runbook. Assignments: Sam=telemetry PR; Kai=console mock; Priya=runbook & comm; Elena=rollout policy update.
Sam: I'll add the changelog note for the rollback and the planned follow-up.
Elena: Closing thread for now. Ping if urgent. :thumbsup:
